title: Resolve the two DOC admission residues exposed by change 0640 and expose stylesheet leniency through the facade
code_state: PapBinTable trims one proven PAPX word-alignment byte at its consumer; FBKF.ibkl uniqueness remains strict; litchi::Document adds bounded path and byte entry points carrying litchi_doc::OpenOptions; no CFB path, parser limit, writer encoding or default route changes
reason_codes: MS-DOC FBKF explicitly requires ibkl to be unique within a Plcfbkf/Plcfbkfd, so watermark.doc remains a typed refusal even though its duplicate and unused PlcfBkl slots carry the same CP
PapxInFkp's cb=0 form stores an even 2*cb' byte container; the POI witness repeats a complete odd SPRM sequence followed by one zero alignment byte in all 24 PAPX entries

the PAPX admission strips one byte only after strict SPRM parsing identifies an exact one-byte trailing opcode error; parse_sprms remains strict and malformed nonzero or incomplete operands remain errors
the existing OpenOptions/Leniency contract is now reachable through litchi::Document without changing default strict behavior

accepted_evidence.specification: Microsoft Learn MS-DOC FBKF, Plcfbkf, PapxInFkp and GrpPrlAndIstd pages linked by the change record
accepted_evidence.witnesses: direct unified-facade tests over watermark.doc, poi/test-data/document/test.doc and duplicate-style-names.doc
accepted_evidence.unit_tests: PapBinTable alignment and malformed-tail tests plus the global SPRM trailing-zero refusal test
accepted_evidence.corpus: the 57-file inventory and 0640 retained corpus scan; no new full differential claimed
accepted_evidence.facade: both bounded path and owned-byte leniency routes produce the same text on duplicate-style-names.doc

accepted_costs.FBKF: the duplicate-bookmark fixture remains unavailable under strict reading, as required by the normative uniqueness rule
